description: Prepare parking: an out-of-range liquidity position's whole liquidity is pulled out on its own DEX (manager and id from gage_park_positions), and the one token it holds is deposited into the partner vault named, which must take it (USDG, or a lend asset; ETH is not parked yet); its fees come to the wallet. Refused while the position is in range. Its transactions are built from one reading of the chain: send them in order (calls) or as one batch, without preparing again between them. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

id.description: The position's id at its manager (gage_park_positions id): its NFT's token id, or a Fables range's id

manager.description: Where the position is held: its position manager (a Uniswap v3, SushiSwap v3 or Ramses V3 NonfungiblePositionManager, or a Uniswap v4 PositionManager), or a Fables hook for its receipts (gage_park_positions manager)

maxSlippageBps.description: Most the conversion may move against you, in bps; 50 when omitted

vault.description: The partner vault to park in: one that takes the token the position holds now (gage_park_positions vaults; a DEX names its own)

name: gage_prepare_park
title: Prepare: Park an out-of-range position
